description: The authoritative shapes for every artifact an agent authors from scratch. An agent fills a template; it never copies another story's artifact. A completed story is evidence of what was decided for that story, not a standard - it is itself agent output, so treating it as authority lets a past agent's choice become the rule with no human having ratified it.

notTemplated.reason: An RTM partition is merged by key, never authored from a blank. A template would invite a monolithic RTM, which is the one shape the scaling design forbids. The schema at traceability/schemas/rtm.schema.json remains the authority.

Authored by the bug-analyzer from a real execution record, with fields such as the failure fingerprint computed at runtime. A blank would be filled from evidence, not from a shape. The schema at defects/schemas/defect-report.schema.json remains the authority.
